from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def authorize(payment_id: str, invoice: Invoice, amount, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record("payment_authorized", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment

import pytest

    )

    assert payment.status == "authorized"

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

def mk(status="captured", amount="100.00"):
    return Payment("p", "i", Decimal(amount), status=status, created_at=T0, captured_at=T0)

# partial then full
p = mk()
assert refund(p, Decimal("40.00"), T0) is p
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("40.00") and p.status == "captured"
refund(p, "60.00", T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("100.00") and p.status == "refunded"

# over-refund
p = mk()
refund(p, "60", T0)
try:
    refund(p, "50", T0); raise AssertionError
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured"

# wrong state
for st in ("authorized", "voided", "refunded"):
    try:
        refund(mk(st), "1", T0); raise AssertionError(st)
    except BillingError as e:
        assert e.code == "invalid_state"

# zero / negative / float / bool
for bad in (0, "-1", 1.5, True):
    try:
        refund(mk(), bad, T0); raise AssertionError(bad)
    except BillingError as e:
        assert e.code in ("non_positive_amount", "float_amount"), (bad, e.code)

# naive datetime
try:
    refund(mk(), "1", datetime(2026,1,1)); raise AssertionError
except BillingError as e:
